name: PWZ-029
summary: PWZ-029 is a benzodiazepine derivative drug with nootropic effects developed by WiSys, It acts as a subtype-selective, mixed agonist-inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine binding site on the GABAA receptor, acting as a partial inverse agonist at the α5 subtype and a weak partial agonist at the α3 subtype.

pharmacology.text: PWZ-029 is a benzodiazepine derivative drug with nootropic effects developed by WiSys, It acts as a subtype-selective, mixed agonist-inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine binding site on the GABAA receptor, acting as a partial inverse agonist at the α5 subtype and a weak partial agonist at the α3 subtype.

uses.text: PWZ-029 is a benzodiazepine derivative drug with nootropic effects developed by WiSys, It acts as a subtype-selective, mixed agonist-inverse agonist at the benzodiazepine binding site on the GABAA receptor, acting as a partial inverse agonist at the α5 subtype and a weak partial agonist at the α3 subtype.

fact.en: PWZ-029 was developed through WiSys, the organisation that handles inventions from the University of Wisconsin System. It was designed to work only on certain types of GABA-A receptor rather than all of them, as most benzodiazepines do.
fact.zh: PWZ-029 是透過 WiSys 開發的，這個機構負責管理威斯康辛大學系統的發明。它被設計成只作用於特定類型的 GABA-A 受體，而不像多數苯二氮平那樣作用於全部類型。
